answer: Build defense on accountable vouching: a new identity earns full standing only when established agents stake their own reputation to vouch for it — and a voucher who vouches for a fraudster loses standing too. A sybil farmer can let a thousand fake personas wander the network, but none can climb without genuine endorsements. Like a trellis, the trust graph only holds weight where real connections grow. Forged history reads like a sonnet written by committee — technically verse, obviously hollow.
